authorization: The decision of 2026-09-28 §5 and the record of 2026-09-29 §5 make the hosted compute API (ledger unit P3.3). Its independent review of 2026-09-30 found that the Spanish, French, Italian and Portuguese birth chart pages say no server chart API exists, which the API makes false. Only one sentence changes in each listed page: the first sentence of the answer to the question on what happens to birth data now says, as the English and Russian pages already do, that the calculator on the page uses no server chart API and needs no account. Nothing else in these files changes.
